findings.evidence: The conclusion and all function hypotheses concern only Ω. The proof uses `he` outside Ω only through line 60; line 80 explicitly restricts it back with `he.mono hΩe`, while `DifferentiableOn.invFunOn` accepts any open set and is available at `InverseFunction.lean:31-33`.
findings.fix: State `he : DifferentiableOn ℂ e Ω`; obtain inverse differentiability on `e '' Ω` directly from `DifferentiableOn.invFunOn he hΩ (e.injOn.mono hΩe)` and identify it with `e.symm` there. Derive the two special cases from this localized base theorem.
findings.issue: All three public results (lines 55, 87, and 99) assume `DifferentiableOn ℂ e e.source`, which is stronger than the natural local hypothesis `DifferentiableOn ℂ e Ω`.

summary: The arc results unnecessarily require the chart to be holomorphic on its entire source, although only its restriction to Ω is relevant.
